lead.flag: Front page · Sunday Edition · Game day
lead.headline: Four Quarterbacks Are Out, and This League Owns Their Replacements
lead.deck: Tanner McKee, Jalon Daniels and Deshaun Watson all start for league rosters today. Jeff Longwood's upset of the week is brimley over #StopAsianHate, the champs meet Jackie aCHANe in a battle of 4-1 teams, and Stroke The Post is a 51.8-point favorite over the commissioner.

stories.role: Sunday Picks · Never Met a Parlay He Didn't Like
stories.headline: Green Bay Is the Upset, Ray Davis Is a Crime, and I Lost My Shirt in Denver
intro: Thursday night I had Seattle minus 2.5. Denver won 17-14 in overtime when Sam Darnold threw it to Ja'Quan McMillian, and I watched Will Lutz hit a 53-yarder through my soul. Denver gained 168 yards and still won. Football is a crime scene. Five of our teams already have Thursday points banked: #StopAsianHate has 40.0 thanks to Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 12 catches for 134 yards, Very Naughty Boys has 26.62, Ben Football Team 17.0, Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 6.4 and Panic Trade Project 4.48 off Bo Nix's 107 passing yards.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and total. I checked CBS Sports' DraftKings board from Saturday morning against VegasInsider and FOX Sports. Where the books split on Saints-Giants, I'm calling it a pick'em at 46. Panthers-Eagles is Carolina by 2 at 40 after Jalen Hurts was ruled out.

The board in one breath: the Rams are implied for 32 against Arizona, the fattest number of the week. Buffalo is 29.25 against the Raiders, San Francisco 29.5 on Monday night, Green Bay 27.5 and Dallas 26 in a 53.5 shootout. The sewer: the Chargers at 17 without Joe Alt, the Jets at 18 without Breece Hall, Cleveland and Tampa at 18.25. Four starting quarterbacks are out — Hurts, Lamar Jackson, Baker Mayfield and Dillon Gabriel — and three of the guys replacing them start for teams in this league. God help us all.

sections.note: Send Nudes. Six starters in offenses implied for 25-plus, two of them in the 32-point Rams offense. Jackie's 4-1 is built on the softest schedule in the league.
p: Two 4-1 teams, and only one of them is real. Send Nudes beat all 11 other teams in Week 4 and again in Week 5, when it hung 248.7. Jackie aCHANe scores 111.7 a game, eighth in the league, and has faced 80.3 a game, the softest schedule anybody has drawn. Its luck factor is +2.45, the highest in the league. That's not a contender, that's a guy who found a wallet.

The champs are missing Jahmyr Gibbs, Ja'Marr Chase and Joe Burrow to byes and still project 155.9. The reason is the Rams. Los Angeles is a 12.5-point favorite over Arizona in a 51.5 game, implied for 32, and Send Nudes has Kyren Williams (21.03) and Puka Nacua (22.64) in it. Derrick Henry (17.68) runs behind Tyler Huntley in Cleveland, Baltimore implied for 21.25, which is ugly but it's Henry.

Here's what keeps the line from being 50. Four Send Nudes starters are questionable: A.J. Brown (ankle, limited all week), Tyler Warren (groin), Pat Freiermuth (calf) and Mike Evans (ribs, Monday night). Kirk Cousins is a quarterback in a 53.5 game against Buffalo, so I'll allow it. Aaron Rodgers is in Tampa with Pittsburgh at 20.75.

Jackie's best spots are Matthew Golden (15.35) and Tucker Kraft (12.92) in the Green Bay offense at 27.5, and Daniel Jones in the Colts' 25.75 offense, where he'll be throwing to Send Nudes' Tyler Warren and Keenan Allen. Woody Marks gets the Houston backfield with David Montgomery out, but that's the London game with Houston implied for 20. Jaleel McLaughlin is in Cleveland at 18.25. Kendrick Bourne is on the Cardinals. I'm laying the 35.6 and I'm not even sweating.

sections.note: UPSET. brimley has three starters in the 27.5-point Green Bay offense. #StopAsianHate's best week already happened Thursday, and its quarterback is Deshaun Watson in an 18.25 game.
p: #StopAsianHate leads 40 to nothing. Smith-Njigba caught 12 balls for 25.4 points and RJ Harvey scored on a direct snap for 14.6. The books have them by 9.8. I'm telling you the best part of their week is in the rearview mirror. Strip out Thursday and the rest of that lineup projects 118.0 against brimley's 148.2, with an average implied total of 22.3 to brimley's 23.9.

Start with Green Bay. Packers by 1.5 over Dallas, total 53.5, Green Bay implied for 27.5. brimley has Jordan Love (20.57), Christian Watson (18.21) and MarShawn Lloyd (12.33) in that offense: quarterback, receiver and running back from the same team in the highest-total game of the afternoon. #StopAsianHate has George Pickens on the other side. Three to one in a shootout. I like those odds better than my marriage.

Now look at the other quarterback. Hurts is on IR with a blood clot in his calf and Lamar is out, so #StopAsianHate starts Deshaun Watson, Cleveland implied for 18.25. Dallas Goedert catches passes from Tanner McKee, Philadelphia at 19. Zay Flowers catches them from Huntley. Jaylen Warren is in Tampa at 20.75. Kenneth Walker in the Kansas City offense (24.5) is the only scary piece left, and he's projected 22.81.

brimley's depth fits the scripts. Saquon Barkley and Will Shipley are both out, so Dameon Pierce is Philadelphia's lead back. Trey McBride (16.48) plays for a 12.5-point underdog, which means Arizona throws all afternoon. DJ Moore (questionable, shoulder, limited Friday) is the one risk, but he's in a 29.25 Buffalo offense, and Stefon Diggs on the bench plays Monday if he can't go. brimley, outright. I'm betting the watch. The good watch.

sections.note: Stroke The Post. Seven starters in offenses implied for 25-plus. Sheev has 40 points riding on one Monday night game.
p: I feel for the commissioner, I really do. Sheev scores 155.4 a game, fourth in the league, faces 155.8 a game and is 1-4. Its luck factor of -2.18 is the worst in the league by more than half a win. Today isn't bad luck, though. Today is a 51.8-point line.

Stroke The Post has seven starters in offenses implied for 25 or more, the most on the slate. Matthew Stafford (21.54) gets the 32-point Rams. CeeDee Lamb (19.77) and Javonte Williams (17.44) face Green Bay with Dallas at 26. Jonathan Taylor (23.03) is in a 25.75 Colts offense against Tennessee. Drake London is at 25.5, James Cook against the Raiders at 29.25, Caleb Williams in Atlanta at 27.

Caleb is questionable with the hamstring, practiced fully all week, and told reporters he doesn't know if he's playing. Stroke has Michael Penix (14.62) on the bench, and Penix plays in the same game, so the swap is clean if Caleb is inactive. Chris Olave is questionable with an illness after a limited Friday.

Sheev's whole week lives on Monday night. Jayden Daniels (17.39) and Brock Purdy (22.61) play each other, 49ers by 7.5 at 51.5. That's 40 projected points in one game. Before that, Quinshon Judkins (questionable, ankle) and Harold Fannin are in Cleveland at 18.25 with Gabriel out, and TreVeyon Henderson is questionable at 5.94. Luther Burden in Chicago and Khalil Shakir in Buffalo are the bright spots. Stroke covers by lunch on Monday.

sections.note: Ben Football Team. Very Naughty Boys has an extra 9.6 banked, then starts a running back Sleeper lists as out.
p: Very Naughty Boys leads 26.62 to 17.0, which is the most fun anybody on that roster has had all year. Darnold threw two picks, including the overtime one that cost me money, and still scored 13.02. J.K. Dobbins ran 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown for 13.6. Ben has Rashid Shaheed's 11.8, built on a 42-yard catch and a two-point conversion, and Emanuel Wilson's 5.2.

Then the lineup gets ugly. Jacory Croskey-Merritt is in a starting slot, and Sleeper lists him as out with the groin. He plays Monday, so there's time to swap him, but Very Naughty Boys has nobody on the bench projected for 8 points. Tanner McKee, claimed for $35 on Thursday, starts at quarterback in Philadelphia's 19-point offense. Colston Loveland (CHI, 27) and Dalton Kincaid (BUF, 29.25) are the good spots, with DeMario Douglas in New England at 25.5.

Ben's quarterbacks are better. Patrick Mahomes (18.61) faces a Chargers team without Joe Alt and Derwin James, Kansas City implied for 24.5 with Rashee Rice out. Jameis Winston is in the Giants' pick'em at 23. Tyler Higbee, claimed for $7 on Friday, plays in the 32-point Rams offense. Chuba Hubbard (15.98) runs for a Carolina team favored over a quarterback-less Philadelphia.

The worry is DK Metcalf, a late addition to Pittsburgh's report with an illness who didn't practice Friday. Even if he sits, Ben's remaining lineup projects about 90 to Very Naughty Boys' 61. Ben Football Team, minus the 32.5.

sections.note: Bijan Your Face. Both sides of a 53.5-point Bills-Raiders game, Davante Adams in the 32-point Rams offense, and a 92.9-point projected margin.
p: Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 is 5-0 and scores 194.4 a game, the most in the league. ClutchJuice projects 77.3 points for the whole week. The line is 92.9. I've seen closer fights at a christening.

Bijan has both sides of Bills-Raiders, total 53.5: Josh Allen (24.96) with the Bills implied for 29.25, plus Ashton Jeanty (15.68) and Brock Bowers (16.87), who was cleared from his knee issue. Davante Adams is in the 32-point Rams offense. Christian McCaffrey plays Monday with San Francisco at 29.5. Bijan Robinson (25.12) is at home against Chicago in a 52.5 game. DeVonta Smith is cleared too, although he catches passes from McKee. Jaylen Waddle already banked 6.4 through his shoulder on Thursday.

ClutchJuice's lineup is a hostage video. Drake Maye (20.69) is the real thing, New England implied for 25.5 against the Jets. Then it starts three Jets: Braelon Allen (13.44) and Isaiah Davis (4.85), who split Breece Hall's carries, and Mason Taylor, all in an offense implied for 18 as a 7.5-point underdog. Darius Cooper catches from McKee. And Ray Davis is in a running back slot projected for 1.0.
Kyle Pitts, the $90 tight end, gets Atlanta at 25.5. Good for him. Bijan, and I'm parlaying it with my rent.

sections.note: God Bless Vodka. Panic's quarterbacks are Bo Nix's 4.48 and a backup in an 18.25 Tampa offense.
p: God Bless Vodka has lost four straight. Panic Trade Project is 2-3 and scores 88.7 a game. One of these teams wins today, and the league doesn't care which.

Panic already burned a quarterback slot: Bo Nix went 17 of 27 for 107 yards for 4.48 points, in a game Denver won with 168 total yards. The other quarterback is Jalon Daniels, claimed for $0 on Thursday for Tank Dell, starting for Tampa with Mayfield out. Tampa is implied for 18.25 against Pittsburgh, and Emeka Egbuka rides with him. Carnell Tate and Tyjae Spears (questionable, knee) are Titans, implied for 18.75. Keaton Mitchell is a Charger, and the Chargers are at 17.

God Bless Vodka has the better spots. George Kittle (15.11) plays Monday night in San Francisco's 29.5 offense. Josh Downs has the Colts at 25.75 and Jake Ferguson in Dallas at 26. Tyler Allgeier (13.43) is Arizona's back with Jeremiyah Love out. Nico Collins (18.25) loses Tank Dell and David Montgomery around him, which means more targets in London.

The bad news: Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton are in the 17-point Chargers offense, the worst number on the board, without Joe Alt. Doesn't matter. Vodka by 28.6, and somebody please check on both of these managers.

stories.headline: Four Quarterbacks Down, and Three of the Backups Start Here
paragraphs: Good morning. Four starting quarterbacks are out today, and this league is unusually exposed to it. Jalen Hurts (#StopAsianHate's IR) has a blood clot in his calf, so Tanner McKee starts for Philadelphia, and McKee belongs to Very Naughty Boys, which paid $35 for him Thursday. Baker Mayfield (Send Nudes' IR) is out with the thumb, so Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa, and he belongs to Panic Trade Project. Lamar Jackson (#StopAsianHate bench) is out again, and Tyler Huntley starts for Baltimore. Huntley is a free agent: Very Naughty Boys dropped him Thursday for DeMario Douglas.

The fourth is Cleveland's Dillon Gabriel (back). #StopAsianHate is starting Deshaun Watson, Sleeper projects him for 13.81, and with Hurts and Jackson both down he is the only quarterback that roster has playing today. Cleveland is implied for about 18 against Baltimore. That matters for Quinshon Judkins and Harold Fannin (Sheev), KC Concepcion (Very Naughty Boys), Denzel Boston (Ben Football Team) and Jaleel McLaughlin (Jackie aCHANe).

Running backs. Saquon Barkley (brimley bench) and Will Shipley are both out, which leaves Dameon Pierce (brimley) at the top of Philadelphia's depth chart. Breece Hall (Sheev bench) is out with a quad injury, so ClutchJuice starts both Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis. David Montgomery (Jackie aCHANe bench) is out, so Woody Marks (Jackie aCHANe) leads Houston's backfield. Jeremiyah Love (God Bless Vodka bench) is out, which leaves Tyler Allgeier (God Bless Vodka) as Arizona's lead back. Kyle Monangai (Sheev bench) is out again. Rashee Rice (#StopAsianHate bench) is out with hamstring and knee injuries.

The questionable list is long, so here is how to read it. Caleb Williams (Stroke The Post) practiced fully all week, which is a good sign, though he has said he doesn't know whether he'll play. Chris Olave (Stroke The Post) was limited Friday after an illness. DJ Moore (brimley) returned to a limited practice Friday. A.J. Brown and Tyler Warren (Send Nudes) were limited, Brown all week. TreVeyon Henderson and Judkins (Sheev) were limited. DK Metcalf (Ben Football Team) is the late addition: an illness, and he didn't practice Friday. Pat Freiermuth (Send Nudes) and Tyjae Spears (Panic Trade Project) are also questionable.

On the good side, DeVonta Smith (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦), Brock Bowers (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦) and Ladd McConkey (#StopAsianHate) were all cleared. Jaylen Waddle played through his shoulder on Thursday and scored 6.4.

Two timing notes. Houston and Jacksonville play in London this morning, so lineups with Parker Washington, Nico Collins, Brian Thomas, Trevor Lawrence, Bhayshul Tuten, Woody Marks or Jakobi Meyers lock early. And I could not find Monday's final designations for Washington or San Francisco. Sleeper lists Jacory Croskey-Merritt (Very Naughty Boys) as out with a groin injury and Mike Evans (Send Nudes) as questionable with his ribs. A questionable tag tells you the risk, not who plays. Inactives come about 90 minutes before each kickoff, and that's the only list that counts.

lead.headline: Jackie Pays $23, Cuts Him a Week Later, Pays $14 Again
lead.deck: Jackie aCHANe swapped Will Shipley for Jaleel McLaughlin and is down to $14 of FAAB. The champs bought two starters for $12, sold Kyle Pitts for $90, and now hold the biggest budget in the league.

stories.headline: One Week, $23 and a Release
paragraphs: Wednesday's waiver run cleared nine claims, and the one people will be talking about is a cut. Last Wednesday, Jackie aCHANe won a four-team auction for Will Shipley at $23. He started, scored 8.3, and this Wednesday Jackie released him to make room for Jaleel McLaughlin at $14. Sleeper now lists Shipley as doubtful and fifth on Philadelphia's running back depth chart, so I understand the cut. I don't understand the price: Panic Trade Project bid $6 and Sheev bid $1. Jackie left $8 on the table and starts McLaughlin this week at 5.01 projected.

Here's the part I like. McLaughlin is second on Cleveland's depth chart behind Quinshon Judkins, who is questionable with a lower-leg injury. Judkins belongs to Sheev, and Sheev's $1 bid on his own handcuff lost. Sheev also lost Kimani Vidal by $2. He settled for George Holani at $0, cutting Athan Kaliakmanis, the quarterback he paid $5 for a week ago. Holani starts tonight in Denver, projected for 6.0.

Jackie wasn't done. It paid $11 for Jayden Reed, the receiver Sheev released on Oct. 10. Sleeper lists Reed on injured reserve, and the only other bid was ClutchJuice at $0. On Sunday, Jackie also won Kendrick Bourne for $8 over Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 ($6) and Ben Football Team ($5), and Bourne starts this week. That's $33 in one week. Jackie has spent $86 of its $100, and only ClutchJuice has less left.

The other $14 claim was Kimani Vidal. Panic Trade Project won him over Sheev ($12) and Bijan ($2) and cut Jaylen Wright. Panic now starts both Keaton Mitchell and Vidal, the two backs behind Omarion Hampton in Los Angeles. Hampton starts for God Bless Vodka, Panic's opponent this week. That's a bet on Hampton's workload shrinking, made in the Chargers offense Vegas likes least this week. Panic did better on Saturday, when it got Tyjae Spears for $3 over Bijan's $1 and watched him score 9.8.

Best value of the run goes to the defending champs. Send Nudes paid $6 for Pittsburgh tight end Pat Freiermuth, outbidding Stroke The Post ($2), #StopAsianHate ($2) and Bijan ($0), and cut Courtland Sutton. It paid another $6 for Keenan Allen over Bijan's $3 and cut Mac Jones. Both start this week. A few hours later, Send Nudes traded Kyle Pitts to ClutchJuice for Ben Football Team's 2027 third-round pick and $90 of FAAB. Freiermuth projects 8.9 this week. Pitts projects 8.1. Mona Lott grades the trade below.

Further down the bill: #StopAsianHate paid $5 for New England back Corey Kiner, Bijan paid $2 for Samaje Perine and cut Dalton Schultz, and Stroke claimed Ryan Flournoy for $0. Bijan also released Tua Tagovailoa, about two days after trading for him. #StopAsianHate cut Mike Gesicki and ClutchJuice cut Chris Brooks.

Who still has ammunition: Send Nudes now has $117, the most in the league, after starting the season with $100. A 4-1 defending champion with the biggest budget is a problem for everyone else. God Bless Vodka ($96) and Bijan ($91) are next. At the bottom, ClutchJuice has $9 after sending $90 in the Pitts trade, Jackie has $14 and Panic has $25. When the next starting job opens, those three can't compete for it.

stories.headline: Byes, Holes and a Schedule Reckoning
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood handles those on Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 6. Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami and Minnesota are on bye. Send Nudes loses Jahmyr Gibbs, Ja'Marr Chase and Joe Burrow for the week. Ben Football Team loses Jared Goff, Sam LaPorta and T.J. Hockenson, which leaves it with an empty tight end slot as of Thursday morning.

The game of the week is a test of the schedule. Send Nudes and Jackie aCHANe are both 4-1, and that's about all they have in common. Send Nudes scores 188.2 a game. Jackie scores 111.7, eighth in the league, and has allowed 80.3, the fewest by 18.0 points. By all-play, Jackie has played like a 1.55-win team, which makes it 2.45 wins luckier than its scoring suggests, the biggest gap in the league. Send Nudes projects 151.9 to 117.2, with most of its edge at running back. The one unknown is A.J. Brown, who is in Send Nudes' lineup at 11.91 projected but is still listed on injured reserve.

Tonight's game is Seattle at Denver, with the Seahawks favored by 2.5 to 3.5 and a 40.5 total. Seven league starters play in it. The biggest is #StopAsianHate's Jaxon Smith-Njigba at 22.16. Very Naughty Boys has Sam Darnold and J.K. Dobbins, Panic Trade Project has Bo Nix, Ben has Emanuel Wilson, Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 has Jaylen Waddle and Sheev has George Holani. One more timing note: Houston and Jacksonville play in London on Sunday at 8:30 a.m. Central. Sheev's Parker Washington, God Bless Vodka's Nico Collins and Brian Thomas, brimley's Trevor Lawrence, Ben's Bhayshul Tuten and Jackie's Woody Marks and Jakobi Meyers lock early.

Follow the implied totals. The Rams are 12.5 to 13.5-point favorites over Arizona with a total around 52, which implies about 32.5 points, the most of the week. Buffalo at Las Vegas (about 29.6) and San Francisco against Washington (29) are next. Stroke The Post has seven starters in offenses implied for 25 or more, the most in the league, and Send Nudes has six. Ben has one, Patrick Mahomes. At the bottom, the Chargers are implied for about 17 at Kansas City. Panic starts two Chargers running backs. God Bless Vodka starts Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton.

Superflex check. Panic and Very Naughty Boys each start one quarterback, and neither has a second quarterback with a Sleeper projection this week. Panic has receiver Jalen Coker in its superflex slot. Very Naughty Boys has Jordan Addison there. He is out, and Minnesota is on bye anyway, so that slot projects zero. Add Tre' Harris (doubtful, no projection) and VNB projects 74.1, the lowest in the league. Bijan, by contrast, gets 43.5 projected points from Josh Allen and Dak Prescott, the most of any quarterback pair.

The closest projected game is brimley against #StopAsianHate, 160.8 to 150.7. Both are 2-3, and both are there partly because of their opponents: they have allowed the most points in the league, 172.9 and 165.7 a game. The loser falls to 2-4. The positional edges point opposite ways. brimley has the better quarterbacks by 10.6, #StopAsianHate has the best running back projection in the league at 68.4.

intel.note: Two 4-1 teams built very differently. Send Nudes scores 188.2 a game, second in the league. Jackie aCHANe scores 111.7, eighth, and has allowed 80.3, the fewest in the league by 18.0 points. Send Nudes leads at running back by 19.0 and tight end by 9.2 even with Jahmyr Gibbs, Ja'Marr Chase and Joe Burrow on bye. The swing piece is A.J. Brown: he's in Send Nudes' lineup at 11.91 projected, but Sleeper still lists him on injured reserve and New England hasn't said whether he's activated.

The widest projected gap of the week, 92.4 points. Bijan Your Face 🍆💦's running backs alone (60.6) out-project ClutchJuice's receivers and tight ends combined (38.9). ClutchJuice leads the league in lineup efficiency at 96%, so there's no hidden bench help. Kyle Pitts debuts for ClutchJuice at 8.1. On Bijan's side, Brock Bowers (knee) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) are questionable, and Jaylen Waddle plays tonight in Denver.

Stroke The Post out-projects Sheev by 53.9, and 41.9 of that is at running back: Jonathan Taylor, Javonte Williams and James Cook against Quinshon Judkins (questionable, lower leg) and George Holani. Stroke has seven starters in offenses Vegas implies for 25 or more, the most in the league. Its risk is health: Caleb Williams (hamstring) and Chris Olave (illness) are both questionable. Sheev's quarterbacks, Brock Purdy and Jayden Daniels, face each other in Washington-San Francisco, the last game of the week.

The closest projected game, 10.1 points. These two are 2-3, and they've allowed the most points in the league: brimley 172.9 a game, #StopAsianHate 165.7. brimley leads at quarterback by 10.6 with Jordan Love and Trevor Lawrence. #StopAsianHate's backs project 68.4, the best running back group in the league this week. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (22.16) plays tonight. brimley's Saquon Barkley (hamstring) and DJ Moore (shoulder) are questionable, and Lawrence kicks off in London at 8:30 a.m. Central.

Panic Trade Project starts one quarterback in a superflex league: Bo Nix, with receiver Jalen Coker in the superflex slot. God Bless Vodka's Cam Ward and Justin Herbert give it a 14.1-point edge at quarterback, and its tight ends lead by 18.9. Odd wrinkle: Panic's two starting backs, Keaton Mitchell and Kimani Vidal, back up Omarion Hampton, who starts for God Bless Vodka. All three play for a Chargers offense implied for about 17 points at Kansas City, the lowest team total of the week.

Ben Football Team's tight end slot is empty. Sam LaPorta and T.J. Hockenson are on bye, and Oscar Delp (1.53 projected) is on the bench. Ben still projects 38.2 points ahead because Very Naughty Boys has bigger holes: Jordan Addison (out, and Minnesota is on bye) sits in its superflex slot and Tre' Harris (doubtful) is in a receiver slot, neither with a projection. Tonight: Sam Darnold and J.K. Dobbins (21.73 combined) for VNB, Emanuel Wilson (12.84) for Ben.

thursday.intelNote: Proj = sum of Sleeper's Week 6 projections for each starting lineup as set Thursday morning. Starters without a Sleeper projection (Jordan Addison, out; Tre' Harris, doubtful) and Ben Football Team's empty tight end slot count as zero. Vegas lines are consensus numbers from VegasInsider, Complex (Fanatics Sportsbook) and SportsBrackets as of Oct. 13–15. Cincinnati, Detroit, Miami and Minnesota are on bye.

lead.headline: 0.14! 0.54! THE BENCH WINS FOUR GAMES AS BIJAN GOES 6-0
lead.deck: Send Nudes beats Jackie aCHANe by 0.14 without Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase or Jahmyr Gibbs. Very Naughty Boys post their season high and lose by 0.54 with J.J. McCarthy's 17.32 on the bench. Bijan Your Face is the last unbeaten team, and four of the six losers had a winning lineup sitting on their own roster.

stories.headline: Two Games Decided by Less Than a Point, and Four Losers Who Had the Answer on the Bench
intro: Week 6 in one sentence: four NFL teams were on bye, scoring fell to its lowest level of the season, and the lineup decisions mattered more than ever. The league averaged 120.68 points, the lowest of any week this year, and the week's top score, Stroke The Post's 151.98, is the lowest top score of any week.

Four losers had a winning lineup on their own rosters: Jackie aCHANe, Very Naughty Boys, #StopAsianHate and God Bless Vodka. Bijan Your Face is 6-0. Send Nudes and Ben Football Team are 5-1, and Stroke The Post and Jackie aCHANe are 4-2. brimley and Panic Trade Project are both 3-3, and brimley holds the sixth and final playoff spot on points scored, 908.46 to 551.32. #StopAsianHate and ClutchJuice are a game back at 2-4. Here is every game.

p: Send Nudes won 118.34 to 118.2. The 0.14-point margin is the closest game of the season, and the champions did it without four of their best players: Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase and Jahmyr Gibbs were on bye, and Tyler Warren is listed out. Send Nudes' best possible lineup was 118.34, so for the second straight week it left nothing on the bench.

The fill-ins carried it. Kirk Cousins scored 19.52 at superflex, Aaron Rodgers 17.02 at quarterback, Keenan Allen 16.2 on a 9.59 projection and Rachaad White 15.7 on 10.98. The stars underneath were quiet: Kyren Williams scored 9.7 against a 21.03 projection, Derrick Henry 5.0 against 17.68 and Puka Nacua 14.0 against 22.64. Send Nudes was projected for 155.9 on Sunday and scored 37.56 fewer.

Jackie aCHANe will be thinking about one decision. Terry McLaurin started and scored 3.7, and he is now listed out with a knee injury. Bryce Lance scored 8.9 on the bench. That swap alone makes it 123.4 to 118.34, a Jackie win. Matthew Golden scored 22.4 and Bryce Young 19.84, and Jackie scored only 2.07 fewer than its starters' projected total of 120.27. It lost by less than the 5.5 it left on the bench.
sections.note: Send Nudes has won five straight and is 5-1 with 1,059.18 points, second in the league. Jackie aCHANe falls to 4-2.

p: Very Naughty Boys scored 114.42, its best score of the season by 16.76, and lost by 0.54. It was a 32.5-point underdog on Sunday's lineup projections and beat its starters' projected total of 89.16 by 25.26.

The loss was on the bench. Very Naughty Boys claimed Tanner McKee for $35 on Thursday and started him at superflex, where he scored 12.6. J.J. McCarthy scored 17.32 on the bench. That one swap is worth 4.72 points, and the game was decided by 0.54. On Monday afternoon Very Naughty Boys also traded a 2027 fourth-round pick to God Bless Vodka for Austin Ekeler and started him. He scored 2.7. The good news was real: DeMario Douglas, a $1 claim on Thursday, scored 19.6 on a 4.28 projection, Colston Loveland scored 18.5 and J.K. Dobbins 13.6.

Ben Football Team won while scoring 6.27 below its starters' projected total of 121.23. Bhayshul Tuten scored 24.7, DK Metcalf 20.3 after his 5.3 debut, and Chuba Hubbard 19.1. Its quarterbacks combined for 19.96: Patrick Mahomes scored 11.48 on an 18.61 projection and Jameis Winston 8.48. Ben's last two wins have come by 4.56 and 0.54.
sections.note: Ben Football Team is 5-1 with the seventh-most points in the league and the best luck rating, +2.36. Very Naughty Boys is 0-6.

p: brimley was a 9.8-point underdog on Sunday's lineup projections and won 141.48 to 128.86, the second-highest score of the week. Malik Nabers scored 28.5 on a 14.17 projection and Trevor Lawrence 28.34 on 18.21. Jordan Love added 21.24 and Dameon Pierce 15.0. MarShawn Lloyd scored 1.0 on a 12.33 projection while Stefon Diggs scored 16.4 on the bench, but brimley did not need him.

#StopAsianHate had the win on its roster. Cam Skattebo started at superflex and scored 0.0 against a 12.04 projection, and Blake Corum scored 14.0 on the bench. That swap makes it 142.86 to 141.48. #StopAsianHate also got 3.6 from Rhamondre Stevenson against a 15.01 projection and 9.46 from Deshaun Watson at quarterback. Kenneth Walker scored 27.9 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba 25.4, and #StopAsianHate banked 40.0 from Smith-Njigba and RJ Harvey on Thursday night. It was not enough.
After the game, brimley traded Jonathon Brooks to Panic Trade Project for Tre Tucker. Mona Lott grades it below.
sections.note: brimley has won two straight and holds sixth place at 3-3. #StopAsianHate has lost three straight and is 2-4.

p: Bijan Your Face won 137.12 to 103.5 and is the only unbeaten team left. It was a 92.9-point favorite on Sunday's projections and won by 33.62. Its 137.12 is its lowest score of the season. Christian McCaffrey scored 30.7, the best score by any starter in the league this week, and DeVonta Smith added 20.5.

The rest underdelivered. Bijan Robinson scored 7.3 against a 25.12 projection, Davante Adams 6.9 against 16.63 and Josh Allen 18.3 against 24.96. Tyler Shough scored 26.96 on the bench, the best bench score in the league, while Dak Prescott scored 13.02 at superflex. Bijan left 22.34 on the bench and still won by 33.62.

ClutchJuice played a perfect lineup, 103.5 points, and beat its starters' projected total of 77.33 by 26.17, the largest overperformance in the league this week. Germie Bernard scored 25.7 on a 10.07 projection, Drake Maye 23.8, and Kyle Pitts, acquired from Send Nudes on Oct. 14, scored 23.0 on a 7.58 projection in his first game for ClutchJuice. Rashod Bateman started and scored 0.0; he is now listed out with a shoulder injury.
sections.note: Bijan Your Face is 6-0 with a league-best 1,109.04 points. ClutchJuice is 2-4.

p: Stroke The Post won 151.98 to 124.96 with the highest score of the week, and it still left 26.8 points on the bench, the most in the league. Michael Penix scored 23.1 there while Matthew Stafford (16.88) and Caleb Williams (16.5) started, and D'Andre Swift scored 23.0 on the bench while Javonte Williams scored 13.0. Stroke's best possible lineup was 178.78.
James Cook scored 24.3 and Jonathan Taylor 21.1. CeeDee Lamb, questionable after last week, played and scored 16.0. Stroke was a 51.8-point favorite and won by 27.02.

Sheev had the same problem it had last week, at a smaller scale. C.J. Stroud scored 23.98 on the bench while Brock Purdy scored 17.36, the second straight week Stroud outscored Purdy from the bench. Harold Fannin scored 1.9 in the flex while Brenton Strange scored 9.4 on the bench. CJ Donaldson, bought from brimley for $3 on Friday, started and scored 1.9. Isaiah Likely scored 23.9 and Jayden Daniels 21.0. Sheev's best lineup was 145.18, which would still have lost.
sections.note: Stroke The Post is 4-2 with the third-most points in the league. Sheev is 1-5 despite the fifth-most points, and its -2.82 luck rating is the worst in the league.

p: Panic Trade Project was a 28.6-point underdog and won 108.04 to 86.34. Tre Tucker scored 26.7 on a 9.06 projection, Carnell Tate 19.0, Emeka Egbuka 17.8 and Jalen Coker 15.7. Jalon Daniels, a $0 waiver claim on Thursday, scored 13.16 at superflex. Bo Nix scored 4.48 and the two starting running backs combined for 2.2, while Omar Cooper scored 22.3 on the bench.
Hours after the game, Panic Trade Project traded Tucker, its leading scorer this season with 78.5 points, to brimley, the team it is tied with for sixth.

God Bless Vodka scored 86.34, the lowest score of the week, and the win was on its bench. Brian Thomas started and scored 0.0 while Jaylin Noel scored 20.7 on the bench, and Cam Ward scored 7.78 at superflex while Geno Smith scored 12.98 on the bench. Those two swaps make it 112.24 to 108.04. Nico Collins scored 10.9 on an 18.25 projection. George Kittle, at 17.9, was the top scorer. On Monday, God Bless Vodka traded Austin Ekeler to Very Naughty Boys for a 2027 fourth.
sections.note: Panic Trade Project is 3-3, tied with brimley and behind it on points. God Bless Vodka has lost five straight and is 1-5.

stories.headline: The Bench Went 4-0 This Week
paragraphs: Four teams lost this week with a winning lineup sitting on their own roster. Jackie aCHANe lost by 0.14 with Bryce Lance's 8.9 on the bench. Very Naughty Boys lost by 0.54 with J.J. McCarthy's 17.32 on the bench. #StopAsianHate started Cam Skattebo at superflex for 0.0 with Blake Corum's 14.0 on the bench. God Bless Vodka started Brian Thomas for 0.0 with Jaylin Noel's 20.7 on the bench. If the bench were a team, it would be 4-0, and it would be better managed than most of you.

Send Nudes played without Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, Jahmyr Gibbs and Tyler Warren, started Kirk Cousins, and won. Its best possible lineup was 118.34. It scored 118.34. That's two perfect lineups in a row. The champion isn't the best team in this league on paper anymore, but its lineup calls haven't missed in two weeks, and this week that was worth exactly 0.14 points.

Very Naughty Boys, I need to talk to you. You put up your best score of the season, 114.42. You paid $35 for Tanner McKee and started him over J.J. McCarthy, and McCarthy outscored him by 4.72. You lost by 0.54. Then, the same Monday, you traded a 2027 fourth for a 31-year-old running back, started him, and got 2.7. You're 0-6 and you own three 2027 firsts. Act like it. Sell the veterans. Don't buy them.

Ben Football Team is 5-1. Ben is seventh in points. Ben's last two wins came by 4.56 and 0.54. Ben has the best luck rating in the league at +2.36. Somewhere a four-leaf clover is filing a missing persons report.

Panic Trade Project's Tre Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday, the most on its roster and the best game of his season. A few hours later Panic Trade Project traded him to brimley, the team it is tied with at 3-3 for the last playoff spot, for Jonathon Brooks, a running back who hasn't scored a point since Week 2 and is on NFL injured reserve. The team name was a warning label, and I respect a franchise that lives its brand.

Jeff Longwood went 5-1, and his upset of the week, brimley over #StopAsianHate, came in. His lock, Bijan Your Face by 92.9, won by 33.62, which only counts as a lock if you don't read the number. Week 7 games to circle: Bijan Your Face, 6-0, against Jackie aCHANe, 4-2, and brimley against Stroke The Post, the team that just traded for Tucker against the team with the highest score of the week.

projNote: Live projections are banked Thursday points plus Sleeper's Week 6 projections for every Sunday and Monday starter, as lineups stood early Sunday. Starters without a Sleeper projection count as zero.

breakdown.headline: The Unluckiest Team in the League Keeps Paying for Depth
p: Sheev is 1-4 and sixth in dynasty value at 65,974, down one spot from last week. The scoring says it should be better than that. Sheev averages 155.4 points a game, fourth in the league, and has faced 155.8 a game, the third-toughest schedule. It has 3.18 all-play wins and one real one. Its luck factor of -2.18 is the worst in the league, and the next-worst team, #StopAsianHate, is at -1.45.

The roster is young and clean. Value-weighted age is 24.6, third-youngest in the league, 52% of the value sits in players 25 or younger, and nothing is tied up in players 30 or older. Brock Purdy (6,079) and Jayden Daniels (5,681) are the two starting quarterbacks, Tetairoa McMillan (4,933) and Parker Washington (4,226) lead the receivers, and C.J. Stroud (3,924) sits on the bench.

The weak spot is running back, and this week shows why. Breece Hall (3,615), Sheev's most valuable back, is out with a quad injury. Kyle Monangai is out. The two backs in the lineup, Quinshon Judkins and TreVeyon Henderson, are both questionable with ankle injuries.

That explains Friday's trade. Sheev sent $3 of FAAB to brimley for CJ Donaldson, a 22-year-old Saints rookie worth 188 on the market. brimley had claimed him off waivers for $0 two days earlier. The same afternoon Sheev released Dohnte Meyers, a $25 waiver claim from Week 5. It is a small trade, but it continues a pattern: three trades in two weeks, all for depth. Sheev has $27 of FAAB left.

The draft capital is all borrowed. Sheev's own 2027 first belongs to Very Naughty Boys, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third and 2028 second to Jackie aCHANe, its 2028 first to ClutchJuice and its 2028 third to brimley. It holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected late, 2,549), #StopAsianHate's 2028 first and second, and Bijan Your Face's 2028 third. Pick value is 7,177, seventh in the league.
breakdown.verdict: A young, high-scoring roster with the worst luck in the league and no draft picks of its own through 2028.
breakdown.move: Trade C.J. Stroud, the third quarterback, for a starting running back. That fixes the real hole without spending another pick.

breakdown.headline: A Rebuild That Bought 27-Year-Olds
breakdown.verdict: Stuck between windows. Jeremiyah Love is the future. Nico Collins and Chase Brown are the present. There are no firsts.
breakdown.move: Pick a direction. At 1-3 with no first-round picks, sell George Kittle and Geno Smith now and build around Love, Omarion Hampton and Cam Ward.
p: God Bless Vodka is 1-3, ninth in scoring at 112.0 a game, and ninth in dynasty value at 53,020. The all-play mark of 1.55 says the record is about fair.
The best asset is Jeremiyah Love (5,935) at 21.3, the 19th most valuable player in the league. Hampton (23.5) and Ward (24.3) give the roster a young second layer. Jadarian Price remains on IR.

The Oct. 5 trade is the puzzle. Vodka sent Matthew Golden, its own 2028 first and fourth, and Bijan Your Face's 2027 first and third to Jackie aCHANe for Nico Collins (27.5), Chase Brown (26.5) and Jackie's 2028 second. That's a win-now trade from a team our model calls a rebuild. The result: value-weighted age rose to 26.0, and only 43% of value is in players 25 or younger.

The pick cupboard is nearly empty. Bijan Your Face owns Vodka's 2027 first and second, and Jackie aCHANe owns its 2028 first. What's left is its own 2027 third, two 2028 seconds (its own and Jackie's) and its own 2028 third, 4,851 in all.
Kittle is 33.0 and still starting. A tight end that age is a depreciating asset with injury risk every week. Sell him while he still scores.

breakdown.headline: Gibbs and Chase Sat Out, and the Champs Still Project 155
p: Here's what I'm hearing around the league: nobody wants to see Send Nudes in December. The defending champs are 4-1, second in dynasty value at 74,056 and second in player value at 67,168. They score 188.2 a game, second only to Bijan Your Face. In Weeks 4 and 5 they beat every other team in the league, and they put up 248.7 in Week 5.

This week they did it without their three most valuable players. Jahmyr Gibbs (10,947), Ja'Marr Chase (8,804) and Joe Burrow (6,413) are all on bye, and the lineup still projects 155.9. Puka Nacua (8,396) and Kyren Williams (4,507) carry it.

The front office sold Kyle Pitts to ClutchJuice on Wednesday for Ben Football Team's 2027 third and $90 of FAAB. On Friday it spent $7 of that on Christian Kirk. Send Nudes now has $110 of FAAB, the most in the league by $14. That's the insurance policy for a roster with four starters on the injury report this week.

And it needs one. Value-weighted age is 28.2, the oldest in the league, and 38% of the value sits in players 30 or older: Derrick Henry is 32, Mike Evans 33, Kirk Cousins 38 and Aaron Rodgers 42. Baker Mayfield and Deebo Samuel are on IR. The champs don't own their 2027 first or second, which belong to Very Naughty Boys. They do hold their own 2028 first, second and third, plus two 2027 thirds. Pick value is 6,888, eighth in the league.
breakdown.verdict: The best team in the league not named Bijan, built on old players and the biggest waiver budget in the league.
breakdown.move: Use the $110 when the next injury hits, and sell one of Henry, Evans or Cousins at the deadline while they still score.

breakdown.headline: The Pick Pile Bought a Tight End
p: ClutchJuice is 2-3 after back-to-back wins, but the scoreboard isn't the point. It ranks 10th in dynasty value at 50,914, last in player value at 24,264, and first in draft capital by a wide margin at 26,650. That pick value is more than the player value.

Here's the board. ClutchJuice owns three 2027 firsts: its own, which projects early (5,022), plus brimley's and #StopAsianHate's, both projected mid-round (3,307 each). It has three 2027 seconds, two 2027 thirds, and two 2028 firsts, its own and Sheev's. No one else is close.

On Wednesday it spent some of the cushion. ClutchJuice gave Send Nudes Ben Football Team's 2027 third and $90 of FAAB for Kyle Pitts. Pitts is 26 and worth 1,884, its second-most valuable player, and he starts right away. The cost: ClutchJuice has $9 of FAAB left, the least in the league.

The roster is the youngest-but-one in the league, with a value-weighted age of 24.2 and 82% of the value in players 25 or younger. Drake Maye (6,980) is the franchise, and he is almost 29% of the team's player value by himself. The weekly product is still thin: 88.5 points a game, 11th, and a +1.18 luck factor that makes the 2-3 look better than it is. This week ClutchJuice is starting Ray Davis, projected for 1.0.
breakdown.verdict: The best pick portfolio in the league, attached to the thinnest roster. The rebuild is on schedule.
breakdown.move: Turn one of the mid-round 2027 firsts into a young starting running back now, and stop spending FAAB on veterans.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, and a $3 Flip
p: brimley is 2-3 and moved up to fifth in dynasty value at 66,367. No team has had it harder. brimley has faced 172.9 points a game, the toughest schedule in the league, while scoring 153.4, fifth. Its luck factor of -1.09 is the third-worst in the league. Our model projects 7.9 wins.

The value sits in a few big pieces: Trey McBride (7,071), Justin Jefferson (6,463, on bye this week), Malik Nabers (6,147) and Trevor Lawrence (5,734). Jordan Love (4,439) and Christian Watson (3,910) give brimley a Green Bay stack. Saquon Barkley (2,856) is out with a hamstring injury and Travis Etienne is on IR, which is why Dameon Pierce is starting.

The week's business was small. On Wednesday night brimley released Tyler Higbee, the tight end it traded for in Week 5, to claim CJ Donaldson for $0. On Friday it traded Donaldson to Sheev for $3 of FAAB. Ben Football Team claimed Higbee for $7. brimley has $82 of FAAB left.

The age profile is the concern. Value-weighted age is 26.9 and only 22% of the value is in players 25 or younger. Jefferson is 27, Watson 27, Love 28. brimley's 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice. It holds its own 2027 second and third, Stroke The Post's 2027 third, its own 2028 first and second, and Sheev's 2028 third. Pick value is 8,513, sixth.
breakdown.verdict: A good team with the worst schedule in the league and no 2027 first. It should make the playoffs, but the window is now.
breakdown.move: Buy a running back with the $82 and a 2027 third. Barkley is 29 and hurt.

breakdown.headline: The Name Is Panic. The Plan Is Patience.
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild, and a well-stocked one. Youngest roster in the league and the third-most draft capital. The 2-1 record is borrowed.
breakdown.move: Don't be fooled by 2-1. Sell anything older than 26 for 2027 picks and keep stacking.
p: Panic Trade Project is 2-1. Panic Trade Project is not a 2-1 team. The all-play mark is 0.73, meaning a typical schedule produces fewer than one win. The luck factor is +1.27, the most in the league, helped by just 91 points allowed per game, the second-easiest schedule.
But I don't think bhegg97 cares about this season, and he shouldn't. This is the youngest roster in the league by value-weighted age, 23.9, with 84% of its value in players 25 or younger.

The quarterback plan is a three-way bet: Bo Nix (26.6), Jaxson Dart (23.4), the most valuable player on the roster, and rookie Ty Simpson on the taxi squad. The receiver room is all youth: Emeka Egbuka, Carnell Tate (21.7), Makai Lemon, Jalen Coker, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Rome Odunze. Running back is the hole. Keaton Mitchell and Jaylen Wright are FAAB adds, and Kaleb Johnson came over in the ClutchJuice trade.

The draft capital is 15,321, third-most in the league: its own 2027 first, Stroke The Post's 2027 first, 2027 seconds from Sheev and Ben Football Team, its own 2028 first, and 2028 seconds from Stroke and itself.

Its own 2027 first slots mid-round right now because of the 2-1 record. The model projects only 5.0 wins, the third-fewest in the league, so that pick should climb. The trades have a plan, even if the team name doesn't.

breakdown.headline: Two Quarterbacks Down and No First-Round Picks
p: #StopAsianHate is 2-3 and fourth in dynasty value at 67,068, down one spot. The scoring is better than the record: 152.7 a game, sixth, against the second-toughest schedule in the league, 165.7 a game. Its luck factor of -1.45 is second-worst, behind only Sheev.

The diagnosis this week is at quarterback. Lamar Jackson (6,575) is out with his ankle injury again. Jalen Hurts (3,818) is on IR with a blood clot in his calf, which is a different kind of problem from a sprain. Deshaun Watson is the only healthy quarterback on the roster, and he starts in a Cleveland offense implied for about 18.

The rest of the roster is in good shape. Jaxon Smith-Njigba (9,625), 24, is the most valuable player on the roster and scored 25.4 on Thursday. Kenneth Walker (6,855), Zay Flowers (4,779) and George Pickens (4,170) are all 26 or younger. Rashee Rice is out with hamstring and knee injuries, and Ladd McConkey (2,920) was cleared for the week but sits on the bench.

The draft capital is thin. #StopAsianHate's 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice, and its 2028 first and second belong to Sheev. It holds its own 2027 second, two 2027 thirds (ClutchJuice's and Jackie aCHANe's), and its 2028 third. Pick value is 4,906, ninth.
breakdown.verdict: A strong skill-position core with no healthy starting quarterback and no first-round picks to buy one.
breakdown.move: Trade from receiver depth, McConkey or Rice, for a second starting quarterback before the bye weeks pile up.

breakdown.headline: The Rare Team That Wins Now and Later
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power. Best roster today and the most draft capital of any contender.
breakdown.move: Sell Davante Adams, Dak Prescott and Tyreek Hill while they still return value. None of them will matter in 2028.
p: Bijan Your Face isn't just the best team in the league. It's the best-built one. Its dynasty score of 92,605 is more than 22,000 points clear of second-place Send Nudes.

Start with the core. Bijan Robinson (24.6), Brock Bowers (23.8) and Ashton Jeanty (22.8) are the third, seventh and 13th most valuable assets in all of dynasty, and none is older than 25. Josh Allen is No. 1 overall in superflex. Amon-Ra St. Brown is No. 8 and in his prime. Most teams in this league have one or two foundation pieces. This one has five.

The risk is the back half of the roster. A third of the team's value sits in players 29 or older: Allen and Christian McCaffrey (both 30.3), Dak Prescott (33.2), Davante Adams (33.8) and Tyreek Hill (32.6). Allen ages well because quarterbacks do. The rest are the kind of assets that lose half their value in a single offseason.

The record is earned. A 3-0 start with an all-play mark of 2.73 means Bijan would have beaten 91% of the league in an average week. Luck is a rounding error at +0.27. The model projects 11.8 wins, the best in the league.

And the cupboard is real. Bijan traded its own 2027 first to God Bless Vodka but holds Vodka's 2027 first and second in return, and Vodka's first currently projects early. Add two 2028 firsts (its own and Ben Football Team's) and Ben's 2028 third. That's 12,847 in draft capital, the most of any team in the top six.

breakdown.headline: Losing Is the Plan, and the Picks Prove It
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild with the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league.
breakdown.move: Keep the youth, keep the picks, and shop Send Nudes' late first for a young back if the price is right.
p: Very Naughty Boys is 0-3 and the model projects just 3.0 wins. For most teams, that's a crisis. For this one, it's a strategy, because Very Naughty Boys owns its own 2027 first, and it currently projects early.

It also owns Sheev's 2027 first, which projects early too after the commissioner's 0-3 start, plus Send Nudes' first. Three 2027 firsts, two of them early, is the most valuable set of 2027 firsts in the league. Add three 2027 seconds (its own, Send Nudes' and Bijan Your Face's) and its own 2028 first. That's 21,023 in draft capital, second only to ClutchJuice.

The young core is promising. Fernando Mendoza (23.0) is on the taxi squad as the quarterback of the future. Colston Loveland (22.5) is a long-term tight end, and rookie KC Concepcion (22.0) is already starting. Value-weighted age is 24.7.

The veterans are where the injury risk lives. Chris Godwin plays for Tampa Bay, which lost Baker Mayfield this week. J.K. Dobbins is listed with a hip issue and no game designation, and running backs with his injury history are year-to-year propositions. Sam Darnold (29.3) is the starting quarterback: a bridge, not a plan.
The luck factor is -0.36, so the record is roughly deserved. That's fine. Every loss this season makes next spring's draft more interesting.

breakdown.headline: Built for Right Now, and Right Now Only
breakdown.verdict: Dynasty power with a short window. Prime-age core, almost nothing in the draft cupboard.
breakdown.move: Use Caleb Williams as the trade chip. He's the roster's most valuable asset and its only young one, and he's the cleanest way to get a 2027 first back.
p: Stroke The Post is the purest win-now roster in the league, and I mean that as a compliment and a warning.

Look at the ages. CeeDee Lamb 27.5, Jonathan Taylor 27.7, Chris Olave 26.2, Drake London 25.2, James Cook 27.0, Garrett Wilson 26.2. Every major skill player is between 25 and 28, exactly where fantasy production peaks. Only 14% of the roster's value is in players 25 and under, the lowest share in the league.

The quarterback room is the oddity. Matthew Stafford is 38.6 and starting at superflex. Caleb Williams, at 24.8 the 11th most valuable asset in dynasty and the most valuable player on this roster, sits on the bench and is out this week with a hamstring injury.
The 3-0 record is real. The all-play mark is 2.73, tied with Bijan for best in the league, and Stroke has topped 178 points every week. The model projects 11.3 wins.

The cost shows up on the draft board. Stroke's 2027 first belongs to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 second to Ben Football Team, its 2027 third to brimley and its 2028 second to Panic. All that's left is its own 2028 first and third, worth 3,065 combined, second-fewest in the league. This roster has roughly a two-season window before the running backs age out, and very little to restock it with.

breakdown.headline: All In on a Hand the Numbers Don't Like
breakdown.verdict: Rebuild by the numbers, managed like a contender. Last in dynasty value with the fewest picks.
breakdown.move: Commit. If Ben is buying, buy one more young running back. Going halfway is the worst outcome.
p: Ben Football Team made three trades in Week 4 and walked out with Patrick Mahomes and Sam LaPorta. Ben is clearly playing to win now. The numbers say he's playing from last place.

Ben Football Team ranks 12th in dynasty value at 40,857. Thirty-one percent of the roster's value sits in players 29 or older, the third-highest share in the league. Mahomes is 31.0. Jared Goff, the other starting quarterback, is 31.9.

The draft cost of the buying spree is steep. Sheev owns Ben's 2027 first. Panic Trade Project owns Ben's 2027 second, and ClutchJuice its third. Bijan Your Face owns Ben's 2028 first and third. Ben has 2,870 in draft capital left, the least in the league: Stroke The Post's 2027 second and his own 2028 second.

The 2-1 record isn't what it looks like either. The all-play mark is 0.82, and the luck factor is +1.18, tied for second-luckiest. The new roster projects better than the old one, but the model still sees 6.1 wins.

There are young pieces here: Bhayshul Tuten (23.6), rookie Denzel Boston (22.8) and LaPorta (25.7). But this is a two-quarterback, 31-year-old core with no first-round picks for two years. If it doesn't make the playoffs this season, the recovery takes a long time.

breakdown.headline: 3-1, Luckiest in the League, and Selling Anyway
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild that finally behaves like one. The record is a schedule artifact, and the pick haul is real.
breakdown.move: Keep selling. David Montgomery (29.3), Jakobi Meyers (29.9) and Terry McLaurin (31.0) won't be worth more than they are now. And start Malik Willis.
p: Jackie aCHANe is 3-1 and 11th in dynasty value at 50,104, down one spot. Both facts make sense. Jackie has faced 84.0 points a game, the easiest schedule in the league, and its luck factor of +1.73 is the highest. The all-play mark is 1.27, ninth.
The lineup efficiency is 76%, the lowest in the league. This week Jackie is starting Daniel Jones (13.17 projected) over Malik Willis (15.66) and Isaiah Williams (7.73) over Terry McLaurin (11.86).

The front office has been busy. On Oct. 5 it sent Nico Collins and Chase Brown to God Bless Vodka for Matthew Golden, Vodka's 2028 first and fourth, and Bijan Your Face's 2027 first and third. On Oct. 7 it sent Aaron Rodgers and Deebo Samuel to Send Nudes for Willis. On Saturday night it sent Khalil Shakir to Sheev for Sheev's 2027 third.

The result is a real pick board: its own 2027 first and Bijan's, three 2027 thirds (its own is gone; it holds Sheev's, Panic Trade Project's and Bijan's), its own 2028 first and Vodka's, and Sheev's 2028 second. Pick value is 14,991, fourth in the league.

The player side is thinner than the record suggests. Bryce Young (4,245) sits on the bench, and De'Von Achane (4,191) is out for the season with a torn ACL. Tucker Kraft and Golden are the only young starters with real value.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 9 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: Panic Trade Project Sells Its Best Scorer to the Team It Is Chasing
tradeGrades.intro: Two new trades since Sunday's edition, both after the Week 6 games. On Monday afternoon God Bless Vodka sent Austin Ekeler to Very Naughty Boys for Very Naughty Boys' 2027 fourth-round pick. Monday night, Panic Trade Project traded Tre Tucker to brimley for Jonathon Brooks. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Winning on value with the wrong timeline is still a bad trade. The three older trades keep the values and grades from the editions that graded them.

sides.reason: brimley gave up 90 in market value, Brooks at 1,407 for Tucker at 1,317, and that is close to even. The fit is strong: Romeo Doubs is on brimley's IR and DJ Moore is listed out, and Tucker scored 26.7 on Sunday and 78.5 in six starts this season. Brooks never scored for brimley and is on NFL injured reserve with an abdomen injury, per Sleeper. A 3-3 team holding sixth place turned a player it couldn't use into a starter, and took him from the team it is tied with.

Panic Trade Project won on value by 90 and got two years younger, which fits its rebuild ranking, seventh in dynasty value. The timing is the problem. It is 3-3, tied with brimley for the last playoff spot, and it sold its leading scorer to brimley hours after his best game, for a running back who can't play right now. Choosing to rebuild is fine. Doing it by strengthening the one team you are chasing, for a player you can't start, is a C.

Very Naughty Boys paid a pick worth 877 for a running back worth 531, a 346-point loss. Ekeler started immediately and scored 2.7 in a 0.54-point loss. The team is 0-6, ranks eighth in dynasty value and owns three 2027 first-round picks, so its window is next year, not a 31-year-old's last season. Because it is 0-6, its own fourth is likely to fall early in the round, which makes the price higher than the market average.

God Bless Vodka claimed Ekeler for $4 on Oct. 4. He scored 5.0 and 2.4 on its bench, and it sold him for a pick worth 877 and a 346-point gain in market value. At 1-5 and 11th in dynasty value, God Bless Vodka should be selling veterans, and this pick comes from the league's only winless team. It's a small deal, but it's done right.

Sheev paid $3 of FAAB for a rookie running back worth 188, and brimley had claimed him for $0 two days earlier. The fit makes sense with Breece Hall and Kyle Monangai out and both starting backs questionable, but Donaldson projects 3.71 this week. Sheev released Dohnte Meyers, a $25 claim, the same afternoon. It's a cheap move, but a team with $27 left is paying a premium for a player who went for $0 on waivers two days earlier.

brimley turned a free waiver claim into $3 of FAAB in two days, and gave up nothing it was using. To get Donaldson it released Tyler Higbee, whom Ben Football Team then claimed. The stakes are tiny, but it's clean business by a team with $82 of FAAB left.

ClutchJuice gave up a pick worth 1,106 for a tight end worth 1,868, a 762-point win on market value. The fit is real: its other tight ends are Cade Otton (728), Mason Taylor (344) and Max Klare (249), and Pitts starts right away, projected for 8.1 against Chicago. The cost is the $90. ClutchJuice is down to $9 of FAAB for the rest of the season, so it is out of every bidding war from here. For a 2-3 team ranked 10th in dynasty value, a 26-year-old tight end is a reasonable build piece, but the price includes almost its entire budget.

Send Nudes lost 762 in market value, and that is the only knock. Hours earlier it claimed Pat Freiermuth for $6, and Freiermuth projects 8.9 this week to Pitts' 8.1. Tyler Warren (4,222) is still its top tight end. The $90 gives the 4-1 defending champs $117 of FAAB, the most in the league, for whatever injury hits next. Ben's pick is likely to land late in the round, since Ben is 4-1. A contender turned its second tight end into a pick and the league's biggest waiver budget without losing points.

brimley gave up Tua Tagovailoa (602) and $15 of FAAB for a tight end worth 911, so it won on market value by 309. Tua was its fourth quarterback behind Jordan Love, Trevor Lawrence and Jacoby Brissett, so it lost nothing it was using. Higbee went straight into the lineup and scored 13.3 in a 214.92-point win. The deduction: he is 33, and brimley is a 2-3 team paying for a short-term piece. For a team fighting for sixth, that's the right kind of rental. Postscript: brimley released Higbee on Oct. 14 to claim CJ Donaldson, and Ben Football Team claimed him for $7.

On paper Bijan lost 309 in market value. In practice it claimed Higbee for $0 on Sunday and flipped him about a day and a half later for a quarterback and $15 of FAAB. In superflex, a fourth quarterback behind Josh Allen, Dak Prescott and Tyler Shough is cheap bye-week insurance. Tua is not Atlanta's starter, so he won't play often. Good hustle, small stakes. Postscript: Bijan released Tua on Oct. 14, and Stroke The Post claimed him for $12.

tradeGrades.note: Week 6 Monday trade values are current as of Oct. 20. Older trades show values as of the edition that graded them. The 2027 fourth is valued at FantasyCalc's generic 2027 fourth-round price. Trade details come straight from Sleeper's transaction records.
